video_title: Melo Sees MVP for Luka, LeBron’s Sixers Are SCARY & Chris Brickley Says NOBODY Beat Melo 1v1

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony picks Luka Doncic as early-season MVP
quotes.excerpt: I will have to go with Luka. At this point, at this point, Luka is doing
quotes.quote: I will have to go with Luka. At this point, at this point, Luka is doing. If you get a healthy Luka, in-shape Luka, and focused Luka, given effort on the defensive end, that is a different Luka right there. If that is sustainable, we are talking about the West a lot different.

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on Luka Doncic's improved conditioning
quotes.excerpt: It would be interesting to see if it is sustainable, 30-80 game. He does it pretty effortlessly.
quotes.quote: It would be interesting to see if it is sustainable, 30-80 game. He does it pretty effortlessly. I never really seen him look like that. Preseason comes and never seen him with that body fat. Season is here and now he is scoring 45, 40. I feel like it has been, he kind of had this planned in the off-season.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony praises Jaren Jackson Jr.'s defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: My MVP so far, Jaren Jackson Jr. of the Memphis Grizzlies. He has been dogging
quotes.quote: My MVP so far, Jaren Jackson Jr. of the Memphis Grizzlies. He has been dogging for a team that I thought was going to be awful this year. I do not think anybody thought Cam Whitmore was going to struggle when he got to the league. I think everyone knew he was going to produce right away. Jaren Jackson Jr., I do not think he was going to start the season like this. He almost looks like a right-handed Brunson sometimes.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Jaren Jackson Jr.'s sustainability
quotes.excerpt: I think it is sustainable for him, barring no injuries. I do not think it is sustainable for the team.
quotes.quote: I think it is sustainable for him, barring no injuries. I think it is sustainable for him. I do not think it is sustainable for the team. I do not know if I am ready to say Memphis is that team. I like where they are at. I like how they are building. I like how they kind of restructured a lot of things. Let Memphis let build on that.

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on the rise of early-season injuries
quotes.excerpt: The new league, it is like, no back-to-backs. They are already on like, Michael Brown for the Nets.
quotes.quote: The new league, it is like, no back-to-backs. They are already on like, Michael Brown for the Nets. He is healthy, but they are like, you are not playing back-to-backs. So I feel like they are already trying to be proactive with it. I do not know the answer to that. I cannot answer. Why are dudes getting injured?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the changing nature of NBA off-seasons
quotes.excerpt: The off-seasons are not the same no more. I think it is a lot more going into the off-season.
quotes.quote: The off-seasons are not the same no more. I think it is a lot more going into the off-season, from a player side. You are working on your game, you are working on your body, you are working on your brand. It is like you are working on all of these things in the off-season. So by the time you go from working out in the gym, individual workouts, and the training that you do to prepare you to just jump-start you. That training is just, it is to jump-start you to the season. Then you got to keep up on them workouts. Because if you just relying on your off-season workouts in January and February, no. What are the work that you are doing on a day-to-day basis to keep your body up?

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on his training philosophy with NBA players
quotes.excerpt: Season would be done, and yeah, we might not be super wearing tear on your legs, but a little bit
quotes.quote: Season would be done, and yeah, we might not be super wearing tear on your legs, but a little bit before draft, you are getting in there and you are working on your skill set. And I look at some of the other stars I have worked with, I feel like you took less time off as far as like, you just love the game. And it shows. If someone asked me who is the most skilled player I have ever worked with, it is like, toss up. It is like Melo, KD, I do not know, it is like you really cannot. And I feel like it is because you never really went too far away from, you never just took, that I remember, you never took months off. You stayed in the gym.

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on players wanting to play Melo 1v1
quotes.excerpt: At any point of his career, everyone wanted to play him 1v1. That was the thing.
quotes.quote: At any point of his career, everyone wanted to play him 1v1. That was the thing. So that was like, at any point literally from Lakers days, everyone wanted to play him 1v1. So I was like, okay, we are going to do this spot. You win game of three, cool, next spot. Best of 10. And I am not going to name the players right now, but it was a lot of players that felt like, we would be in my apartment, and I am like, there is no way he is going to beat me. And I would be, okay, that is, we will see. The film, we are filming it. And until he said he retired, no one ever beat him 1v1.

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on Kyrie Irving's growth and leadership
quotes.excerpt: Shout out to Kyrie too. I feel like he is kind of taking him under his wing a little bit.
quotes.quote: Shout out to Kyrie too. I feel like he is kind of taking him under his wing a little bit. You can tell after the workouts they have been working together. I feel like if you look at his finishing package, you see some Kyrie in it. So I think Kyrie does not get the credit he deserves with that a little bit. Like it was kind of swept under the rug that this man is learning from Kyrie too.

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on Kyrie Irving's mental health and growth
quotes.excerpt: So he took some time off, right? Didn't play the last, was it two seasons or one season? Yeah.
quotes.quote: So he took some time off, right? Didn't play the last, was it two seasons or one season? Yeah. And he is like, coming back, the league is different. He is like, they have these mental health meetings that he is like, they never had before. They have these betting meetings that they did not have before. The gambling has become such a big thing and a lot of money, and he almost feels like he is playing a different sport. I thought that was like, super intriguing because that got me thinking like, it kind of is, like we are in a different landscape 2026 compared to 2023.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Joel Embiid's need to adjust his role
quotes.excerpt: I'm hearing a mature Joel Embiid who's willing to figure this out for the greater good.
quotes.quote: Now I'm hearing a mature Joel Embiid who's willing to figure this out for the greater good. When you start saying that as a player like Joel Embiid and mean it, because a lot of people say it and then they still feel a way when they get home and they still behind the scenes they making calls and they texting and they angry, but they putting this mask on. But I like the fact that he said that because that to me, he wants to figure this out.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Tyrese Maxey's role in the 76ers offense
quotes.excerpt: Maxey is the guy, and I'm going to continue to stand on that.
quotes.quote: Maxey is the guy, and I'm going to continue to stand on that. I said that earlier, that he's the that's he's it goes as he goes. So when you have that in place, that role, now everybody else has a role. It don't matter. LeBron hit it. He won the game offensive rebound putback.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the 76ers' need for Joel Embiid to adjust
quotes.excerpt: The more comfortable that he's going to get in that role, the better.
quotes.quote: The more comfortable that he's going to get in that role, the better. The more comfortable Joel Embiid is going to get in that role, the better. They're going to need big fella. He going to have to close the games. He going to have to when we we got to get a bucket, you still Joel Embiid. But right now, I don't need you working that hard to do that. I need you to be cool with your 17 sometimes, your 14 sometimes.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the 76ers' star-studded roster
quotes.excerpt: Now you got four MVP caliber players on the team.
quotes.quote: If you buy into what we all are now, because now you got four MVP caliber players on the team. So for me to have that selfishness like, nah, hell no, I got to I got to mature, grow up quick. So I'm not ask you to take a lesser role. You're still Joel Embiid. I'm not telling you go sit and be the 15th man. You're still Joel Embiid. You're still the heartbeat of of of this team. You're the anchor of this team.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the 76ers' tactical adjustments
quotes.excerpt: We going to move you from the top of the key.
quotes.quote: Sometimes, Joel Embiid, we going to move you from the top of the key. We going to put you in the corner because now we going to make Cat make a decision. Cat cannot guard the rim and guard you in the corner. It just that's the strategy.

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on the Detroit Pistons as a team to watch
quotes.excerpt: The Pistons are pretty good, man. Right now, the team to beat.
quotes.quote: The Pistons are pretty good, man. Right now, the team to beat. It's tough because you could argue the Pistons are the best team in the East. So right this second, I don't know. Will they develop to get there? I think they I think they could. But right now, I don't know because the Pistons is looking pretty damn good.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the 76ers' potential
quotes.excerpt: I mean, I think it's Philly. The Sixers are going to be everyone's team to beat.
quotes.quote: I mean, I think it's Philly. The Sixers are going to be everyone's team to beat. They going to get it together. The Sixers they going to get it together.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his new farm and Amazon Prime
quotes.excerpt: Lately, when I get some downtime to just chill, I've been spending a lot of it at my new farm.
quotes.quote: Lately, when I get some downtime to just chill, I've been spending a lot of it at my new farm. We call it the Sanctuary. Coming from Brooklyn and B-More, this farm life is new for me. So I'm still figuring out what I need out there. That's where Amazon Prime comes in clutch. I'm always realizing I need something, work gloves, outdoor lights, storage bins, and an extension cord, something for the house. With Prime's fast shipping, I can get what I need and keep it moving.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his career philosophy
quotes.excerpt: For me, the drive was always bigger than basketball.
quotes.quote: For me, the drive was always bigger than basketball. It was about getting to the league, staying there, building businesses, creating opportunities, and continuing to find the next thing, even after people think you've already made it. And that mindset doesn't just turn off once you reach one goal. There's always another level to get to, another idea to build on, another way to keep growing. That drive is part of who I am.

quotes.speaker: Chris Brickley
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on De'Aaron Fox's current form
quotes.excerpt: He is taking more shots per game than anybody in the NBA right now.
quotes.quote: His name is De'Aaron Fox. He is taking more shots per game than anybody in the NBA right now. He is letting that bitch fly every day and I love watching it. His average would be top three all time. Seven games in, has Sacramento already decided that this is De'Aaron Fox's team?

quotes.excerpt: The Kings are taking the approach, you're going to develop out there.
quotes.quote: So, I want to I want to I like giving perspective on the players. Somebody like Sabonis and his situation. I can understand his frustration, right? Because you put so much into this organization. You've helped build, you know what I mean? You put so much and and and then the organization move on, right? And I know it's a business. That's that's just the business of of this, but you got to have some type of sympathy for that for somebody like Sabonis, who who was watching the franchise shift right in front of him. You don't know how to handle that, right? You don't know to support that, you don't know to be angry at it, you don't know like it's it's it's a emotional rollercoaster for somebody like Sabonis in that position. Now the best thing he can do is embrace it.

quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the Sacramento Kings' roster
quotes.excerpt: You got a young killer who's going to be here for a while.
quotes.quote: You got a young killer who's going to be here for a while. And you watching the franchise shift, so work with that. In the time being, let me help shorty out. We ain't good. Let me teach him how to play with a with a with a center like this, who know how to roll, who know how to pass. Let me let me teach him how to play with a big man like that. That to me, that would be the mature thing to do.

quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Brickley on player development and coaching
quotes.excerpt: I think it's on whoever his development guy is at, you know, each player.
quotes.quote: I think it's on whoever his development guy is at, you know, each player. And each team has a has a development guy. You'll see it pregame, they'll be sitting in the sideline watching film before they do their little pregame workout. I think it's on I don't know who that guy is for him, but I think it's on that guy. It's on the staff to kind of I think it's his uncle, uh, was it his cousin, Rashad Phillips on the staff? Yeah, I don't know if he's on the staff, but I know, you know what I mean, he might be the for a while. I just feel like whoever's in his ear is very important.

quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the importance of player development
quotes.excerpt: It's important that in every sport or every genre that you become successful in, that you create something.
quotes.quote: It's important that in every sport or every genre that you become successful in, that you create something. You know what I mean? Not like a school or or an academy, like you have to give back to that sport that way. So I have been thinking about building the the the academy, you know, name TBD, but yeah, I am leaning towards that.

He's he's dribbling in and playing on the mid post, doing the stuff that you teach. I think it's on I don't know who that guy is for him, but I think it's on that guy. It's on the staff.
